categories.evidence: Labeled Tests; modifies unit test setup helpers to reduce test execution time across unit test suites.
categories.rationale: Reduces unit test execution time across test suites by configuring test wallets with a minimal keypool size. Benchmarks show runtime reductions including coinselector_tests dropping from 8.26 s to 3.35 s and wallet_tests from 2.10 s to 1.68 s.
